description: Gin is a Go web framework. Its context object helps read request data and write replies. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Create a practice folder, run go mod init school and go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin@v1.10.0. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.
versionNote: Examples use Gin 1.10 with Go 1.22 or later.
whatYouWillLearn: Send a text reply with Gin
Read a query value with Gin
Share a route prefix with Gin
learningObjectives: Send a text reply with Gin
